brief: The ultimate guide to display type — 6 rules that make headlines unforgettable.

slots.description: A futuristic geometric sans built for bold statements. Unbounded commands attention at any scale with its confident curves and tech-forward spirit.
A high-contrast transitional serif rooted in 18th-century engraving. Perfect for editorial headlines that demand elegance and dramatic contrast.
Inspired by Buenos Aires signage, this geometric sans brings urban confidence to large-scale typography. Highly legible yet unmistakably characterful.
A variable grotesque that morphs from quirky to serious. Its unpredictable letterforms inject raw personality into modern display layouts.
Originally crafted for headlines in 1960s Poland, this geometric sans balances mathematical precision with playful, space-age proportions.
A soft, wonky serif with variable weight and optical sizing. It brings warmth and approachability to display typography without losing authority.
A refined high-contrast serif designed for editorial impact. Its sharp terminals and graceful curves create unforgettable headline moments.

slots.body: Master display typography and make every headline impossible to ignore with these designer-tested rules.
